title: Digimon Adventure:
description: It’s the year 2020. The Network has become something humans can no longer do without in their daily lives. But what humans don’t know is that on the other side of the Network is the Digital World, a realm of light and darkness. Nor are they aware of the Digimon who live there. Fifth grader Taichi Yagami]s mother and little sister Hikari went to Shibuya, and now they’re aboard a runaway train. Taichi hurries to Shibuya to save his mother and sister, but the instant he heads toward the station platform… a strange phenomenon befalls the DigiDestined, and Taichi goes to the Digital World!

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: While preparing for the upcoming school camp, Taichi Yagami is visited by his new neighbor Koshiro Izumi when they learn that Tokyo’s electronic systems have gone haywire, including the city's trains with Taichi's younger sister Hikari and their mother trapped in one. The two youths run to the nearby station where Taichi is suddenly transported to another world located inside the internet, encountering a wounded Digimon called Koromon. Upon making contact with Koromon, Taichi gains a Digivice while Koromon evolves into Agumon. Koshiro, who also obtained his own Digivice, contacts Taichi and informs him that a horde of Digimon called Argomon are responsible for the chaos with Taichi and Agumon battling them to save the former’s family. Though the remaining Argomon evolves into more powerful forms before overpowering them, Taichi and Agumon’s determination triggers the latter’s evolution into Greymon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Yamato joins Taichi and Koshiro on their mission to stop the Argomon hacking into the U.S. military. On their way there, they learn the Argomon hijacked an American nuclear submarine which is about to launch a nuclear missle. Greymon and Garurumon work together to defeat the Argomon leader who evolves into a perfect form. Yamato then comes with an idea to defeat the leading Argomon which would endanger Greymon and Garurumon, but Taichi convinces him to proceed as their Digimon launch point blank attacks at the Argomon leader. But the Argomon leader survives and evolves into his ultimate form as the missile is launched. Koshiro informs them that the missile is targeting Tokyo, and when Taichi and Yamato refuse to give up, their Digimon partners suddenly merge into Omnimon when Hikari and Yamato’s younger brother Takeru came in contact with some feathers falling from the sky.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The US army's tactical network had been corroded by Digimon, causing military systems to go haywire. Taichi and the others fight desperately against the enemy Digimon in order to put an end to the threat of the missile launch, however the more enemy Digimon they defeat, the more they evolve. And finally, the missiles are launched at Tokyo. Furthermore, bullets of light fired by the enemy Digimon hit Greymon and Garurumon directly. Then, an enormous white Digimon appears... !?

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Taichi arrives in a world called the "Digital World" where Digimon live. His classmate Sora appears there, and together with Taichi and Agumon, they begin their journey by heading for a "shrine".

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The time frame for Tokyo's urban functions coming to a halt was drawing near. Taichi, Agumon and Sora head for a "shrine" written about on a lithograph of the Digital World in search of clues. Meanwhile, Koshiro, who is at another location in the Digital World, continues to gather information along with Tentomon, the Digimon he met there, while keeping in contact with Taichi. During that time, Koshiro and Tentomon get swallowed by a mysterious huge Digimon...

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s party comes across an orchard and meets a mysterious girl, Mimi. Taichi and his friends find out that a kingdom is targeted by some ferocious Digimon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The children now know that the Holy Digimon is the key to saving Tokyo from the blackouts. They attempt to cross the sea to get to the continent, but they’re suddenly attacked by a mysterious whirlpool.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The children finally succeed in crossing the sea with Ikkakumon’s help. However, what awaits them on the other side is a fortress full of Digimon…

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The six children and Digimon neutralize the fortress thanks to excellent teamwork. They try to decode the enemy’s communication log and obtain new information about the Holy Digimon. However, it’s not long before new enemies approach the fortress one after another.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The battle between Greymon and Orgemon ended abruptly and now the Chosen Ones discuss their next move. Taichi and Agumon take a chance to defeat the ultimate enemy, so that the others can safely head to their next destination.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The six Chosen Ones who had finally gathered split up again into two teams in order to find the Holy Digimon. As Yamato’s team attempts to cross the desert, they encounter some dust devils.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s team reaches an ancient ruin. While Koshiro tries to analyze the characters on the walls, Mimi and Palmon accidentally fall underground. When they’re in danger, they encounter a kindhearted Digimon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Yamato’s team flies above an endless jungle on Birdramon until they come across a floating fortress. Sora’s caring heart that wants to save Digimon in trouble brings about a new glow on Piyomon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s team reaches a canyon where they are attacked by a swarm of insect Digimon. In the chaos that ensues, Koshiro and Tentomon stand up to protect their friends.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: While Taichi’s team finishes fighting off Oukuwamon and Kuwagamon in the canyon maze, Sora’s team reaches a snowy mountain where they are attacked by a group of Digimon. Joe and Ikkakumon stand up to save Sora from danger.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s team finds a strange cave that leads to Tokyo. Excited to be back, the children attempt to get home through the subway. However, a creepy Digimon prowls the city, and there, the children learn a shocking truth.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Just when Taichi and his friends thought they had finally defeated the enemy in the fake Tokyo, a new enemy appeared. The children work together with their Digimon to take down the eight-headed Ultimate Digimon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: The Chosen Ones worked together and succeeded in defeating Ultimate Digimon Orochimon. However, a mysterious countdown begins. To save Tokyo, they must prevent it from reaching zero

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Thanks to Omegamon’s reappearance, the Mega Digimon Nidhoggmon, was finally defeated. However, Sora and the others disappeared after being swallowed by a storm. Taichi and Yamato, who are left behind in the Digital World sneak into Valvemon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Yamato’s younger brother, Takeru, is unexpectedly found in the Digital World, held captive by a powerful Digimon. With the help of Leomon’s army, Taichi and Yamato attempt to save Takeru.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The Holy Digimon that turned into a Digitama was snatched away, and Taichi and Yamato chase after Skullknightmon. Meanwhile, the rest of the Chosen Ones that are back in Tokyo fight remotely with their partner Digimon in the Digital World.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Thanks to Takeru’s bravery, Taichi and the others found the way into the castle where the Digitama is held. As for the Chosen Ones in Tokyo, they were in a remote battle against Calamaramon to stop an uncontrollable tanker from crashing.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Devimon’s castle collapsed after the fierce battle with Darkknightmon and Taichi’s group comes to face Devimon at last. Meanwhile, the rest of the Chosen Ones and their partner Digimon fight to destroy the obelisk that is transferring energy.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Thanks to Koshiro’s group destroying the obelisk which was transferring energy to the Digital World, Taichi and the others defeated Neodevimon at last. However, Taichi struggles against the overwhelming powers of Donedevimon

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: The battle with Donedevimon is over at last. However, destiny wasted no time in bringing the next adventure to the Chosen Ones. Koshiro’s group is dealing with tanker collisions while Taichi’s group is attacked by a cluster of Mamemon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Taichi has fallen down to the ocean below Cloud Continent with Leomon and the others. Powerful, new Digimon attack them one after another. Meanwhile, Koshiro’s side tries carry out a counterplan to bring the unresponsive ships under control.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s younger sister Hikari and Koshiro's group are brought to the Digital World just in time to save Taichi's group. The Chosen Ones are now reunited once again. However, another disaster, this time at a rocket launch site, hits the real world.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: The Chosen Ones come to face their old enemy, Darkknightmon. Patamon evolves into Angemon again to fight off Darkknightmon. However, the children are all separated and sent to different parts of the continent.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Hikari is suddenly taken away by Skullknightmon and Taichi could do nothing but watch. On his mission to save Hikari, he meets many kinds of Digimon in the jungle and fights for them as the jungle burns.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Taichi and Agumon act as bait so that the jungle’s Digimon can safely escape. However, Metalgreymon’s attacks are useless against the new Mega Digimon that stands in their way.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Taichi and Agumon finally surpassed their limit, and Agumon evolves into Wargreymon. This evolution awakens Lopmon’s long-lost memories. And Taichi learns about the new threat, Millenniumon.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s group is continuing their adventure with Komondomon. They reunite with Takeru and Patamon, who are targeted by Fangmon. However, yet another threat is creeping up on them.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s party finally catches sight of Skullknightmon and Hikari, who was kidnapped. Taichi chases after them, but Hikari is swallowed into the darkness.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: Hikari and Tailmon are finally saved and they join Taichi’s group. Komondomon dives into a sea current to head toward their next destination. As they make their way underwater, they come across a mysterious city.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s party leaves behind the beautiful underwater city and continues their journey toward the Eternal Continent’s center, FAGA. The party swims through the sea caves on Komondomon, but Digimon with powerful, dark energy block their way.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Taichi’s group reunites with Koshiro and Tentomon after rising to the surface. Koshiro figures out a plan to stop the International Space Station from crashing into Tokyo. Will the Chosen Ones make it in time?!

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: With the ISS no longer being a threat, Taichi and his party continues their adventure. Taichi and Sora, who go out to look for food, happen to reunite with Mimi and Palmon. Then they are suddenly pulled into Mimi’s project.

episodes_data.title: Digimon Adventure: Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: Yamato and Gabumon were on their way to rejoin the other Chosen Ones. However, they happened to pass by some mountains where a Digimon with an evil spell is. Now, great danger approaches Gabumon. Can Yamato save Gabumon in time?!
